blocks.html:
The data to update price sets. You can either update price sets with a selector
or by providing IDs in the price set objects to update.

types.name: UpdatePriceSetsStepInput
types.description:
The data to update price sets. You can either update price sets with a selector
or by providing IDs in the price set objects to update.

children.name: selector
children.description: The filters to select which price sets to update.

children.name: $and
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "and" condition.

children.name: $or
children.description: An array of filters to apply on the entity, where each item in the array is joined with an "or" condition.

children.name: context
children.description:
an object whose keys are the name of the context attribute. Its value can be a string or a BigNumberInput. For example, you can pass the `currency_code` property with its value being the currency code to calculate the price in.
Another example is passing the `quantity` property to calculate the price for that specified quantity, which finds a price set whose `min_quantity` and `max_quantity` conditions match the specified quantity.

children.name: id
children.description: IDs to filter price sets by.

children.name: prices
children.description: Filters to apply on a price set's associated money amounts.

children.name: update
children.description: The data to update the price sets with.

children.name: prices
children.description: The prices to create and add to this price set.

children.name: id
children.description:
A string indicating the ID of the price set to update.
If not provided, a price set is created.

children.name: prices
children.description: The prices to create and add to this price set.
